'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**[[2021 Daraa clashes]], [[Syrian peace process]]
***[[Syrian rebel|Rebel fighters]] begin withdrawing from the southern [[Daraa Governorate]] as part of a [[Russia]]n-brokered [[truce]] aimed at ending fighting in the restive [[provinces of Syria|province]]. The rebels will be allowed [[safe passage]] to the [[Syrian opposition|opposition-held]] [[Idlib Governorate|Idlib]] in the north-west as part of the agreement. [https://www.thedefensepost.com/2021/08/25/syria-rebels-leaving-daraa/ (''The Defense Post'' via AFP)]
*[[Boko Haram insurgency]]
**[[2021 Niger attacks]]
***Hundreds of [[Boko Haram]] [[militant]]s attack a [[Niger Armed Forces|military]] post in [[Diffa]], [[Niger]], killing 16 soldiers and wounding nine others. In the ensuing gun battle, around 50 [[Islamist]] [[insurgent]]s were killed. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/boko-haram-attack-kills-16-soldiers-southern-niger-2021-08-25/ (Reuters)]
*[[Dar es Salaam shooting]]
**A gunman [[mass shooting|opens fire]] near the [[government of France|French]] [[embassy]] in [[Dar es Salaam]], [[Tanzania]], killing three policemen and an employee of a [[private security]] company, and wounding six other people. The gunman was shot dead by responding security forces. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/8/25/gunman-kills-several-near-french-embassy-in-tanzania (Al Jazeera)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[OnlyFans]] reverses its decision to ban [[pornography|pornographic]] content, saying in part that the ban is "no longer required due to banking partners’ assurances that OnlyFans can support all genres of creators". [https://www.wabi.tv/2021/08/25/onlyfans-reverses-explicit-content-ban-after-outcry/ (WABI-TV)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Twenty people are killed and 17 others are reported missing in [[landslide]]s in western [[Venezuela]], amid torrential rains. Most of the deaths occurred in [[Tovar Municipality, Mérida|Tovar]], [[Mérida (state)|Mérida]], after the local [[List of rivers of Venezuela|Mocotíes river]] overflowed its banks. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/8/26/death-toll-rises-to-at-least-20-in-western-venezuela-floods (Al Jazeera)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Indonesia]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in Indonesia]] 
****The [[National Agency of Drug and Food Control of Indonesia|Food and Drug Authority]] grants an [[emergency use authorization]] for the [[Sputnik V COVID-19 vaccine]]. [https://nasional.kompas.com/read/2021/08/25/12315951/bpom-terbitkan-izin-penggunaan-darurat-vaksin-sputnik-v (''Kompas'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Japan]]
****The [[Government of Japan|Japanese government]] announces the expansion of the full [[state of emergency]] to eight [[Prefectures of Japan|prefectures]] and the quasi-state of emergency to four prefectures beginning on August 27, which brings the number of prefectures under all types of emergency measures to 33. These emergency measures will remain in effect until September 12. [https://apnews.com/article/business-health-japan-coronavirus-pandemic-936e321a9dc5519313e2a36fe6092583 (AP)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Kazakhstan]]
****[[Kazakhstan]] announces that beginning on August 28, in order to reduce the spread of the COVID-19, unvaccinated people will be banned from entering shopping malls, restaurants and cafés unless they show proof of [[COVID-19 vaccination in Kazakhstan|vaccination]], a negative [[COVID-19 testing|test]] result, or have recovered from COVID-19 within the past three months and have a "green" status on a [[mobile app]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/kazakhstan-bans-unvaccinated-malls-restaurants-weekends-2021-08-25/ (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Laos]]
****[[Laos]] reports a record 952 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 13,909. [https://laotiantimes.com/2021/08/25/covid-19-sweeps-through-savannakhet-as-local-cases-soar/ (''The Laotian Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Taiwan]]
****[[Taiwan]] reports zero [[Community transmission|community transmitted]] cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours for the first time since the country's largest outbreak began in May. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2021/aug/25/taiwan-zero-covid-cases-outbreak-vaccine-test-trace (''The Guardian'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Vietnam]]
****[[Vietnam]] reports a record 12,096 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 377,245. [https://e.vnexpress.net/news/news/vietnam-confirms-12-096-new-covid-19-cases-4346287.html (VNExpress)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in South America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Argentina]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in Argentina]]
****[[Argentina]] announces that it will receive 20 million doses of the [[Pfizer–BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine]] and that these doses will  mainly be used to vaccinate teenagers. [https://www.elcordillerano.com.ar/noticias/2021/08/25/115671-llegaran-al-pais-20-millones-de-vacunas-de-pfizer-destinadas-a-adolescentes (''El Cordillerano'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Brazil]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in Brazil]]
****The [[Ministry of Health (Brazil)|Ministry of Health]] announces that [[Brazil]] will begin offering [[booster dose]]s of the [[COVID-19 vaccine]] to [[immunocompromise]]d people and people over the age of 70 who received their second dose more than six months ago and will also shorten the interval between the first and second doses of the [[Pfizer–BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine|Pfizer]] and [[Oxford–AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine|AstraZeneca]] vaccines to eight weeks beginning in mid-September. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2021-08-25/brazil-to-begin-giving-vaccine-boosters-cut-time-between-doses (Bloomberg)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Australia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in New South Wales]]
****[[New South Wales]] reports a record 919 new cases of [[COVID-19]] in the past 24 hours. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2021-08-25/nsw-records-919-new-covid-cases-two-deaths/100401494 (ABC News Australia)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Switzerland]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in Switzerland]]
***[[Switzerland]] signs an agreement with [[Pfizer]] to supply a total of 14 million doses of the [[Pfizer–BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine]] in 2022 and 2023, which also includes an option to supply an additional 7 million vaccine doses in subsequent years. [https://www.barrons.com/news/swiss-sign-new-pfizer-vaccine-deal-eyeing-booster-shots-01629905707?refsec=afp-news (''Barron's'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[COVID-19 vaccination in the United States]]
****[[The Pentagon]] announces that COVID-19 vaccinations will be mandatory for the [[United States Armed Forces|U.S. military]] after the [[Food and Drug Administration|FDA]] approved the [[Pfizer–BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine developed]] by [[Pfizer]] and [[BioNTech]]. [https://www.usnews.com/news/us/articles/2021-08-25/pentagon-makes-pfizer-vaccine-mandatory-after-fda-approval-memo (U.S. News & World Report)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Arkansas]]
****[[Arkansas]] reports 354 patients that are on ventilators, a new single-day record. [https://www.kait8.com/2021/08/26/arkansas-hits-new-high-covid-19-patients-ventilators/ (KAIT)]
*[[2020–2021 H5N8 outbreak]]
**[[Benin]] identifies an outbreak of the highly contagious [[Influenza A virus subtype H5N1|H5N1]] [[Avian influenza|avian flu]] in [[Sèmè-Kpodji]] and [[Abomey-Calavi]] near the capital [[Porto Novo]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/benin-agriculture-ministry-confirms-h5n1-avian-flu-outbreak-2021-08-25/ (Reuters)]
 
'''Law and crime'''
*[[President of Peru|Peruvian President]] [[Pedro Castillo]] announces that former [[Alberto Fujimori]] advisor [[Vladimiro Montesinos]] has been transferred from the [[Callao]] naval base to the Ancon II prison to finish the remainder of his sentence. [https://andina.pe/Ingles/noticia-peru-vladimiro-montesinos-transferred-to-ancon-ii-prison-858942.aspx (Andina)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2022 Philippine presidential election]], [[2021 PDP–Laban dispute]]
**[[President of the Philippines|President]] [[Rodrigo Duterte]] accepts the nomination of the ruling [[PDP–Laban]] party to run for [[Vice-President of the Philippines]] in the upcoming 2022 presidential elections. [https://www.rappler.com/nation/elections/duterte-accepts-pdp-laban-nomination-run-vice-president-2022 (Rappler)]
*The Iranian [[Islamic Consultative Assembly]] approves all but one of [[Ebrahim Raisi]]'s nominees for his cabinet, including [[anti-West]] [[Hossein Amirabdollahian]] as foreign minister. The designation of [[Ahmad Vahidi]] was also approved as minister of the interior. [[Argentina]] reiterates its "most energetic condemn" to Vahidi's designations as he is wanted by both Argentina and [[Interpol]] for alleged involvement in the 1994 [[AMIA bombing]]. [https://www.notimerica.com/politica/noticia-iran-parlamento-irani-ratifica-practica-totalidad-nuevo-gabinete-ministros-presidente-raisi-20210825174131.html (Notimérica)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/iran-parliament-approves-most-raisi-nominees-hardline-cabinet-2021-08-25/ (Reuters)] [https://www.rfi.fr/en/middle-east/20210825-iran-s-parliament-approves-president-s-cabinet-choices (AFP via Radio France Internationale)]
